description: This Java class defines the ThingTag, representing the ID and revision of a Thing within the Eclipse Ditto framework. It provides methods for creating instances directly or from JSON objects, ensuring encapsulation of these properties.

classes.name: ThingTag
classes.description: Immutable class representing a specific version (revision) of a Thing identified by ThingId, with support for JSON serialization/deserialization.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Static factory method to create a new ThingTag instance given a ThingId and revision.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Creates a ThingTag instance from a JSON object, extracting the ID and revision fields, with validation.
